community.title: Eat, Explore & Live Healthy 🌿✈️
community.description:
### Welcome to Eat, Explore & Live Healthy! 🌿✈️

Welcome to `!eatandexplore@lemmy.world`! We are a vibrant, creator-friendly community dedicated to wholesome cooking, plant-based nutrition, outdoor adventures, and mindful travel. 

Whether you are looking for a quick 30-minute weeknight dinner, vegan comfort food, gluten-free baking, Air Fryer & Instant Pot meals, budget-friendly meal prep, or the best camping & vanlife recipes for your next road trip, you have found your home!

---

### 🔍 Topics & Post Tags (Optional)
To help organize our community and make searching easier, feel free to use these tags in your post titles:
* **[RECIPE]** - Homemade recipes, cozy soups, one-pot meals, salads, or healthy desserts.
* **[TRAVEL & OUTDOORS]** - Travel guides, road trip tips, hiking snacks, and campfire cooking.
* **[HEALTHY LIVING]** - Wellness tips, whole-food nutrition, and sustainable lifestyle habits.
* **[QUESTION / TIP]** - Ask for cooking advice, ingredient substitutions, or travel gear tips.
* **[FOOD PHOTO]** - Show off what you cooked tonight or a great meal from your travels!

---

### 📜 Community Rules & Guidelines
While participating here, you must abide by the [Lemmy.World Terms of Service](https://legal.lemmy.world/tos/). Failure to follow these rules will result in post removal and a ban:

1. **Zero Tolerance for Hate Speech:** Posts or comments that are racist, sexist, homophobic, transphobic, ableist, or promote violence/harassment will result in an immediate permanent ban.
2. **Be Civil & Respectful (No Food Shaming):** Disagreements happen, but personal insults, trolling, or bad-faith debates are not allowed. All healthy diets (vegan, vegetarian, plant-forward, omnivore healthy) are welcome here.
3. **Creator-Friendly Zone (Self-Promotion Allowed):** Unlike other strict communities, **we support original creators!** You are encouraged to share links to your own food/travel blogs, recipe websites, or YouTube channels (including ASMR cooking and vlogs), as long as the content is real, helpful, and not malicious spam.
4. **Authentic Content Only (No AI Slop / No Bots):** We want real food and real travel experiences. Low-effort AI-generated text, fake AI recipes, automated spam bots, crypto scams, or NSFW/gore content will be banned on sight.
5. **Audio, Video & Accessibility:** If sharing videos, ensure the audio is clear and pleasant (cozy cooking sounds, voiceovers, and ASMR are highly appreciated; no loud/distorted troll audio). Adding *alt-text* to your food photos or a brief description in the comments is highly encouraged!

---

### 🌟 Featured Community Resources & Growth
* **Official Recipe Blog:** [Healthy Living Enthusiast](https://healthylivingenthusiast.com/) – Discover cozy vegan soups, easy one-pot meals, and wholesome seasonal baking.
* **Help Us Grow:** Love a recipe or post here? Feel free to **crosspost** it to other relevant Lemmy communities to help fellow foodies and travelers find us!

*Let’s cook, share, and explore the world together!* 🥣🌍
